COMPETITIONS

Competition guide

An introduction to show jumping, cross country, and preparing to enter.

Official-source overviewReviewed Nov 6, 2026
THE QUICK ANSWER

Horses of Hoofprint Bay includes show jumping and cross-country competitions with prize money. Training is part of preparing your horse to qualify.

Show jumping and cross country#

Both disciplines are confirmed by the official store and the publisher. They provide goals for developing a horse, but this wiki does not yet provide a complete list of classes or course layouts.

Before entering#

Read the entry screen, compare its requirements with your horse, and review any displayed costs. This is a suggested preparation checklist. Entry thresholds, penalties, and reward schedules must be documented from the released game.

Use winnings thoughtfully#

Competition prizes support the stable-building loop. Decide whether your next spending priority is the current horse’s needs or expanding the yard. This is general planning advice, not a tested profit-maximizing strategy.

What still needs verification

Research note

Classes, eligibility, entry fees, scoring formulas, and prize tables remain unverified.

This page reflects official descriptions reviewed on November 6, 2026. It has not been verified against a specific playable build. Suggestions are editorial guidance, not tested outcomes.

Frequently asked questions

What competitions are available?+

Official sources name show jumping and cross country.

Can competitions earn money?+

Yes, prize money is explicitly part of the game description.

Where are exact rewards listed?+

Use the current in-game competition information; this wiki has not verified a reward table.
